entities.name: Juan de la Cierva y Peñafiel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan de la Cierva y Peñafiel was a Spanish politician and lawyer, who served during the reign of Alfonso XIII as Minister of Public Instruction and Fine Arts, of the Interior, of War, and of Finance and Development, and in the last government of the monarchy as Minister of Development.
